lastText: STAVKASVODKAHome19141915191619171918-6MANPOWER-6MUNITIONS-5HOME STABILITYIII.1918A Front That Was Still ThereThe army was not spent in June and was not asked to answer a political question it could not survive answering. It is a smaller army and a worse one than 1914's and it is in the field. It does not change what is signed. It changes what the people signing it have behind them while they do.Speculative counterfactualSpeculative. No Russian army of March 1918 was in a condition to affect the terms. This ending supposes one marginally less far gone, and claims nothing beyond the margin.Return to file
